name: Bistro Haus Leithner
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Bistro Haus Leithner in Tirol**

Nestled in the heart of the **Tirol** Alps, **Bistro Haus Leithner** invites you to savor authentic Austrian cuisine in a cozy, rustic setting. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this charming spot offers a warm atmosphere where traditional flavors meet modern hospitality.

Indulge in our signature dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**—a fluffy, caramelized pancake served with powdered sugar and fresh fruit—or enjoy hearty **Tiroler Gröstl**, a rustic potato and bacon hash. Pair your meal with a glass of local **Graubündner** wine or a frothy **Tiroler Bier** from nearby breweries.

Whether you're exploring the scenic **Zillertal** or taking a break after a day on the slopes of **Nordkette**, **Bistro Haus Leithner** is the perfect place to relax and recharge. Come taste the warmth of **Tirol**—one delicious bite at a time.
